title: Too little hand clearance, sides not stated
why: 40 mm fails the rule if any side is next to an obstacle, and the spec does not say: a person decides.

spec.name: Too little hand clearance, sides not stated

wheelchair_space_layout.hand_clearance_m.required: ≥ 50 mm if a side is next to an obstacle
wheelchair_space_layout.hand_clearance_m.rationale: 4.2.2.2(3): the 50 mm applies only to sides next to an obstacle; sides_next_to_obstacle is not supplied and 40 < 50, so the answer depends on it.
